# Runtime hosts

<!-- Generated by scripts/render-hosts.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

The certification report records the capability names advertised by each runtime driver whose complete shared suite passed. Cloudflare and Rivet have host-specific tests, but do not register the shared runtime-driver suite, so this matrix does not present them as certified.

| Host                               | Driver                             | Tier     | Capabilities passed                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | Notes                                                           |
| ---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Node/Bun process                   | `Runtime.layerMemory`              | stable   | admission, approval-suspend, fork-rewind, host-sessions, idempotent-start, operator-explain, operator-resolve-unknown, operator-retry, operator-scan, runTree, runtime, start-by-agent, unknown-agent-on-recovery                                              | not durable across restarts                                     |
| Node/Bun process                   | `Runtime.layerSqlite`              | stable   | admission, approval-suspend, fork-rewind, host-sessions, idempotent-start, operator-explain, operator-resolve-unknown, operator-retry, operator-scan, runTree, runtime, start-by-agent, unknown-agent-on-recovery                                              | single writer                                                   |
| Node/Bun + PostgreSQL              | `generalist/pg`                    | stable   | admission, approval-suspend, host-sessions, idempotent-start, multiWorkerClaims, notificationRecovery, operator-explain, operator-resolve-unknown, operator-retry, operator-scan, runTree, runtime, sqlTransactions, start-by-agent, unknown-agent-on-recovery | multi-writer with advisory locks                                |
| Node/Bun + MySQL                   | `generalist/mysql`                 | stable   | fork-rewind, host-sessions, idempotent-start, operator-explain, operator-resolve-unknown, operator-retry, operator-scan, runtime, start-by-agent, unknown-agent-on-recovery                                                                                    |                                                                 |
| Cloudflare Worker + Durable Object | `generalist/unstable/cloudflare/*` | unstable | not registered                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | runtime-driver suite not registered; promote when all pass      |
| Rivet actor                        | `generalist/unstable/rivet`        | unstable | not registered                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | runtime-driver suite not registered; `@rivetkit/effect` is beta |

## Report lifecycle

The committed [`hosts-report.json`](hosts-report.json) is the last passing evidence for each registered driver. `bun run test` refreshes a row only when that driver's complete runtime-driver suite ran and passed, then checks this generated page for drift. A failed suite fails the test run and does not replace prior passing evidence.

PostgreSQL and MySQL are skipped when their database URL is unset. A skip is represented by no result for that driver in the current run, not by a failure or an empty capability list; the reporter therefore preserves its committed result. CI provides both databases and refreshes both rows. Capability names come from the registered suite dynamically rather than from a list in the renderer.
